en-US.summary: Voice control for your ohMyBuying shopping lists.
en-US.description: Add, remove, and read items on your ohMyBuying shopping lists with your voice. Link your account with a one-time code from the ohMyBuying app, then say things like 'Alexa, ask oh my buying to add eggs to my groceries list'.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask oh my buying to add eggs to my groceries list
Alexa, ask oh my buying what is on my groceries list
en-US.name: ohMyBuying

es-ES.summary: Control por voz de tus listas de compras de ohMyBuying.
es-ES.description: Añade, quita y lee elementos de tus listas de compras de ohMyBuying con la voz. Vincula tu cuenta con un código de un solo uso desde la aplicación, y luego di cosas como 'Alexa, pídele a oh my buying que añada huevos a mi lista de compras'.
examplePhrases: Alexa, pídele a oh my buying que añada huevos a mi lista de compras
Alexa, pregúntale a oh my buying qué hay en mi lista de compras
es-ES.name: ohMyBuying

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Sign up at https://ohmybuying.vercel.app, generate an Alexa link code from the dashboard, then say 'Alexa, ask oh my buying to link with code <CODE>'. After linking, you can add and remove items.
